ghost.sample: Zog was a small dragon. He lived behind the moon. Zog ate clouds and nothing else. One day, he wanted a cloud that was very high. He looked up and sighed. The cloud was near the stars. Zog tried to fly up, but the wind pushed him down. He felt sad and a little mad. Then he saw a mouse on the moon. The mouse said, "Try again." Zog nodded. He took a deep breath and flew once more. This time, he went higher. The cloud came close. Zog opened his mouth and ate it. He laughed right away. The mouse laughed too. They watched the sky turn pink and blue. Then Zog lived behind the moon again, in his safe home. He felt brave and proud.

Zog was a small dragon. He lived behind the moon. He ate clouds every day. One day, Zog saw a big cloud. It was soft and white. He smiled and said, "Cloud, come here." But the cloud was far away. Zog wanted it very much. He flew around the moon and looked again. Then he saw a tiny cloud. It was near and kind. Zog went to it and ate it up. He felt happy. Then he saw two more clouds. He ate them too. The sky looked blue and clean. Zog sat on a moon rock and smiled. A star shone near him. "Good day," said Zog. He lived behind the moon, and that was his nice home. He was a small dragon, and he loved his cloud food. Then he was asleep and dreamed of more clouds.

Sisi was a little cloud. Sisi lived in the sky. Sisi liked to sing songs. One day Sisi looked down and saw a girl with a red ball. The girl waved up high. Sisi felt happy and sang a soft song. The girl smiled. But then the ball rolled away. The girl felt sad. Sisi saw the ball go near a tree. Sisi went down and put the ball back. The girl clapped and said, "Thank you, Sisi." Sisi went back up to the sky. The wind was warm and nice. Sisi sang a new song. The girl listened from the ground. She smiled and waved again. Sisi sang once more. Then the sun came out. Sisi felt proud. The girl danced in the park. Sisi sang and sang. It was a happy day for both of them.

Sisi was a little cloud. Sisi lives in the sky. Sisi likes to sing songs. One night, Sisi saw the moon. The moon was big and white. Sisi said, "Hello, moon." The moon did not talk, but it shone. Sisi sang a sweet song in the sky. A little owl heard the song. The owl said, "I like that." Sisi felt happy. The owl flew by a tall tree and sang too. Then the stars came out, one by one. Sisi and the owl sang to the stars. The sky looked calm and kind. A soft wind moved Sisi and the owl around the moon. The owl felt sleepy, and Sisi sang a tiny song to help. Soon the owl closed its eyes and flew home. Sisi smiled and sang one more song for the moon.

Pip was a tiny robot. Pip loved red apples. Pip slept in a teapot. One day Pip went to the park. He saw a red apple on a bench. He felt very happy. A bird came and looked too. "Hello," said Pip. "I want that red apple." The bird hopped away. Pip went after it. Then Pip slipped on grass and fell on his bottom. The bird stopped and looked sad. Pip smiled. "It is okay," he said. He picked the red apple up. He gave a tiny piece to the bird. The bird was happy. Pip was happy too. Then Pip went back home. He climbed into his teapot. He ate the red apple there. It was a nice end to a funny day.
